response.original_title: 【@faq's>!!10】 How Do I Add a Room to My Carnival Cruise?
response.overview: To add rooms to your Carnival cruise, call Customer Support directly at ☎︎ +1*888*315*9585 (US) or ☎︎ +1*888*315*9585 (AUS) & ☎︎ +1*888*315*9585 (UK or contact your travel advisor. Adding a guest requires available double-occupancy or extra berth space in your ☎︎ +1*888*315*9585 stateroom, plus open shipboard safety capacity. Once confirmed, you must pay the additional cruise fare, taxes, and port charges for the new guest.  Yes, you can add a person to an existing Carnival cruise by calling Customer Support directly at ☎︎ +1*888*315*9585 (US) or ☎︎ +1*888*315*9585
